Auto.CliHelp:
sr "RULE NAME OR ID"
Run a rule in an existing SonicRoute instance from any directory. Quote names containing spaces.
sr --legacy "RULE NAME": target Legacy; Lite is preferred when both editions are running.
Reopen your terminal after the first launch of this build. Fails if the app is not running; never launches it.

SonicRoute.exe --run-rule "RULE NAME OR ID"
Runs a saved rule directly, including rules with automatic triggering disabled; preserves step order and delays.
Uses a running instance; otherwise executes temporarily and exits. Output: one JSON line.
Exit codes: 0=ok, 1=step failed, 2=invalid arguments, 3=not found, 4=duplicate name or ID, 5=busy, 6=server unavailable, 7=canceled, 8=internal error.

Upd.Title: Software updates
Upd.AutomaticHint: Check in the background after startup, at most once every 24 hours; nothing is downloaded or installed automatically.
Upd.Net8Maintenance: The .NET 8-compatible version will receive no new releases or maintenance after November 2026. For later releases, manually migrate via the official release page to the .NET 10 version (filename without the NET suffix) or the Legacy version (.NET Framework 4.8).
Upd.Net8MaintenanceArm64: The .NET 8-compatible version will receive no new releases or maintenance after November 2026. ARM64 users should manually migrate via the official release page to the .NET 10 ARM64 version (filename without the NET suffix).
Upd.Idle: You can check for updates manually.
Upd.Latest: You already have the latest version.
Upd.Available: A new version is available to download.
Upd.MissingPackage: This version has no applicable automatic update package. Download it manually from the full changelog page.
Upd.Ready: The download has been verified and is ready. Restart now to update, or install it later.
Upd.Failed: The update did not complete. Your existing version and settings will be kept.
Upd.Cancelled: Download cancelled. You can download it again.
Upd.Store: The Microsoft Store version is updated through the Store. Check for updates there.
Upd.InProgress: SonicRoute is updating. Please try starting it again later.
Upd.RecoveryRequired: The previous update did not finish. Keep the .sonicroute-update backup and Updates records, then restart or manually restore the previous version before trying again.
Upd.Permission: The program folder is not writable. Move the complete program to a folder writable by the current user and try again, or run as administrator manually if needed. It will not elevate silently.
Upd.RetryHint: Check your network connection or folder permissions and try again. You can also download manually from the full changelog page.
Upd.InstallConfirm: Close SonicRoute, install the verified update, and restart now? Your settings and automation rules will be kept.
Upd.RolledBack: The update failed. The previous version has been restored.
Upd.RecoveryPending: The update was not confirmed as successful. The backup has been kept.
Upd.InstallSucceeded: The update was installed and startup was confirmed.
